summary: > Violence is one of Shadow Stalker's acolytes, first introduced during Operation: Shadow Debt. He takes the form of Limbo wearing Stalker's helmet and the pieces from the Hulta armor set.
> As of Update 29.5 (2020-11-19), Violence can now spawn in The Steel Path missions.
sections: - "(Player), your arrogance will be your demise."
- "(Player), your Lotus will watch you perish."
- When used against the Adaptation mod, Violence's Ice Wave will grant protection against Viral damage instead of Cold damage.
